name: PT Mitra Investindo Tbk
summary: PT Mitra Investindo Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides shipping services in Indonesia. The company offers vessel chartering, ship agency, ship management, and shipping and logistic services. It was formerly known as PT Siwani Trimitra Tbk and changed its name to PT Mitra Investindo Tbk in March 2006. PT Mitra Investindo Tbk was founded in 1993 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
